# SDT (Vitis Unified IDE) build for the axi_can_controller driver. Generated by vivado-axi-ip.
# The generated xaxi_can_controller_g.c lands in this directory and is picked up by the glob.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(axi_can_controller)

find_package(common)
collector_create (PROJECT_LIB_HEADERS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
collector_create (PROJECT_LIB_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
include_directories(${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include)

file(GLOB _drv_sources RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.c")
file(GLOB _drv_headers RELATIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.h")
foreach(_s ${_drv_sources})
  collect (PROJECT_LIB_SOURCES ${_s})
endforeach()
foreach(_h ${_drv_headers})
  collect (PROJECT_LIB_HEADERS ${_h})
endforeach()

collector_list (_sources PROJECT_LIB_SOURCES)
collector_list (_headers PROJECT_LIB_HEADERS)
file(COPY ${_headers} DESTINATION ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/include)
add_library(axi_can_controller STATIC ${_sources})
set_target_properties(axi_can_controller PROPERTIES LINKER_LANGUAGE C)
